facts.value: The routine always resets and force-applies mix controls, selects the saved-language audio configuration, initializes all seventeen playback slots, and restores terminal audio globals. On first use, indicated by installed-language state -1, it keys off all SFX, unloads Synth bank 0, and synchronously loads required slot 0 if absent. Whenever the installed language differs from the selected language, it replaces the AXDriver metadata image, marks bank-tracking entries 1 through 54 inactive, unloads Synth banks 1 and 2, and synchronously ensures slots 51, 1, 54, and 2 are loaded with state 2. If the installed language already matches, that replacement block is skipped.
